paragraphs.text: Lagorin is a mighty quickbeast from Alacria . Bonded with Caradora , together they led the Alacrian Quickbeasts team that competed in the Ghirapur Grand Prix on Avishkar .

Lagorin was the strongest of his district and the clear choice to lead the Alacrian Quickbeasts in the Grand Prix to represent the city's united districts. The ancient beast and the human were not originally bound together but had been forced into a racing pair by tragic circumstances back home. These concerned a training accident whereby Lagorin lost his rider. When his pledged rider died at the cusp of the race, Lagorin was duty-bound to stay the course and take a new rider for the honor of his pledge and the glory of his people. Though reluctant at first, Lagorin has grown to respect Caradora as a worthy partner for his final race before retirement.
